name: fork-identity-guard
description: A reminder, not a boundary: blocks a terminal command when a commit-writing git call it recognises would record an author or committer email other than the one this fork requires, judged from the state before the command runs. It catches common direct cases only. The author of a replayed commit (rebase, cherry-pick, am, pull --rebase) is not checked. Check the resulting commits with git log --format='%ae %ce' before pushing.
author: Leander Metcalf
